{{quote|Take this message back to Sammael. Every death he has caused since waking, I lay at his feet and call due. Every murder he has ever done or caused, I lay at his feet and call due. He escaped justice in the Rorn M’doi, and at Nol Caimaine, and Sohadra . . .' More of Lews Therin’s memories, but the pain of what had been done there, the agony of what Lews Therin’s eyes had seen, burned across the Void as if Rand’s. ' . . . But I will see justice done now. Tell him, no truce with the Forsaken. No truce with the Shadow.|[[Rand al'Thor]] to [[Sammael]]'s messenger}}
